title: The Cold Tea
answer: B, the maid. She said she brought hot tea five minutes ago, but the tea was ice cold. It had been sitting there for ages.

beats.line: Ms. Voss was found dead in her penthouse. Three people were with her. One of them is lying.
It happened at eight o'clock, high above the city.
Suspect A. The chef says he was out shopping for an hour.
Suspect B. The maid says she brought Ms. Voss a hot cup of tea five minutes ago.

visual.name: The Maid
visual.alibi: Brought her hot tea, 5 min ago.

beats.line: Suspect C. The son says he was asleep in his room.
But on her desk, the detective found her cup of tea. It was ice cold.
So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
